import json
import sqlite3
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from jobbot.browser_tasks import enqueue_validation
from jobbot.config import PROJECT_ROOT
from jobbot.orchestrator import launch_browser_run
from jobbot.run_now import ensure_dashboard, preflight
from jobbot.validator import _audit, _free_port, _isolated_bundle, _isolated_environment, _scope_diagnostics, _stop_dashboard, _validation_metrics

root=PROJECT_ROOT
stamp=datetime.now(timezone.utc).strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ')
results=[]
for platform in ('indeed','glassdoor'):
    db=root/'data'/f'readiness_{platform}_{stamp}.sqlite3'
    out=root/'out'/f'readiness-{platform}-{stamp}'
    bundle=_isolated_bundle(db,out,_free_port())
    dashboard_url=None
    try:
        preflight(bundle)
        dashboard_url,_=ensure_dashboard(bundle,open_browser=True)
        with _isolated_environment(bundle):
            run_id=enqueue_validation(root,[platform],bundle=bundle)
            outcome=launch_browser_run(bundle,run_id,wait=True,open_browser=True,timeout_seconds=180,stop_after_seconds=20,startup_timeout_seconds=45)
        audit=_audit(bundle,run_id)
        metrics=_validation_metrics(bundle,run_id,audit)
        scope=_scope_diagnostics(bundle,run_id)
        conn=sqlite3.connect(db); conn.row_factory=sqlite3.Row
        platform_row=dict(conn.execute('SELECT * FROM browser_platform_runs WHERE browser_run_id=? AND platform=?',(run_id,platform)).fetchone())
        task_row=dict(conn.execute('SELECT * FROM browser_search_tasks WHERE browser_run_id=? AND platform=?',(run_id,platform)).fetchone())
        event_types=[str(row[0]) for row in conn.execute('SELECT DISTINCT event_type FROM browser_events WHERE browser_run_id=? ORDER BY event_type',(run_id,))]
        conn.close()
        results.append({'platform':platform,'database':str(db),'output_dir':str(out),'dashboard_url':dashboard_url,'run_id':run_id,'outcome':outcome.__dict__,'platform_state':platform_row,'task_state':task_row,'metrics':metrics,'scope':scope.get(platform,{}),'event_types':event_types})
    except Exception as exc:
        results.append({'platform':platform,'database':str(db),'output_dir':str(out),'dashboard_url':dashboard_url,'error':f'{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}'})
    finally:
        if dashboard_url:
            _stop_dashboard(bundle,dashboard_url)
print(json.dumps({'started_at':stamp,'results':results},indent=2,ensure_ascii=False,default=str))
PY"
